Class CoherenceVectorStore.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.AbstractVectorStoreBuilder<CoherenceVectorStore.Builder>
org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.coherence.CoherenceVectorStore.Builder
All Implemented Interfaces:
VectorStore.Builder<CoherenceVectorStore.Builder>
Enclosing class:
CoherenceVectorStore
public static class CoherenceVectorStore.Builder extends AbstractVectorStoreBuilder<CoherenceVectorStore.Builder>
用于创建CoherenceVectorStore实例的构建器类。

提供用于配置 Coherence 向量存储所有方面的流畅 API，包括地图名称、距离类型和索引选项。

Since:
1.0.0
